spec.description: Upgrades SeaDex recommends for your anime library, findings to check by hand, how your library compares with SeaDex, and whether seadex-scout is healthy.

spec.title: Status
spec.description: ✓ means checks run and nothing fails. ! means SeaDex, AniList or the anime ID map is down, so there is nothing for you to fix. ✗ means an error you can fix or checks that stopped, and Scout health at the bottom says why.

spec.expr:
8 * (sum(absent_over_time({container="$container"} | json msg="msg" | msg=~`cycle complete|cycle degraded|tick complete|tick degraded|reconcile started` [3h])) or vector(0))
+ 4 * (sum(absent_over_time({container="$container"} |= `reconcile complete` | json msg="msg" | msg=`reconcile complete` [72h])) or vector(0))
+ 2 * ((sum(count_over_time({container="$container"} | json level="level", condition="condition" | level=`ERROR` | condition!~`seadex-unreachable|seadex-catalogue-fetch-failing|seadex-window-oversize|anilist-lookups-failing|mapping-refresh-rejected` [1h])) > bool 0) or vector(0))
+ 1 * ((sum(count_over_time({container="$container"} | json level="level", condition="condition" | level=`ERROR` | condition=~`seadex-unreachable|seadex-catalogue-fetch-failing|seadex-window-oversize|anilist-lookups-failing|mapping-refresh-rejected` [1h])) > bool 0) or vector(0))

spec.title: Upgrades and checks
spec.description: Upgrades counts the upgrades SeaDex recommends for what you have, after your filters, and turns blue from 1 to show there is something to grab, not a fault. Upgrades where you already have a SeaDex alt are hidden unless you pick Show under Optional upgrades at the top. Check by hand counts the findings seadex-scout could not decide on its own, and turns yellow from 1 because each one waits for you to look. Both stay green at 0.

spec.expr: count(sum by (al_id, arr, season, recommended_group, seadex_tags, info_hash, title) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `better release available` | json msg="msg", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", season="season", recommended_group="recommended_group", seadex_tags="seadex_tags", info_hash="info_hash", title="title", current_tier="current_tier" | msg=`better release available` | current_tier != "$optional" [2h])))

count(sum by (al_id, arr, season, title, current_group, recommended_group, msg, arr_url) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `manual review` | json msg="msg", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", season="season", title="title", current_group="current_group", recommended_group="recommended_group", arr_url="arr_url" | msg=~`series spans multiple release groups, manual review|release group unverifiable, manual review` [2h])))

spec.title: SeaDex best
spec.description: Share of your anime on SeaDex where every season or film you have is SeaDex's best release. It updates once a day. No summary yet means no daily library summary has arrived in the last 26 hours, or none of your anime is on SeaDex.

spec.expr: max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best="items_all_best" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best [26h])) / (max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_with_entry="items_with_entry" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_with_entry [26h])) > 0) * 100

spec.title: SeaDex alt
spec.description: Share of your anime on SeaDex where you have SeaDex's best or an alt, with at least one alt. SeaDex's best is often a remux, so an anime you keep as encodes usually counts here. It updates once a day. No summary yet means no daily library summary has arrived in the last 26 hours, or none of your anime is on SeaDex.

spec.expr: (max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best_or_alt="items_all_best_or_alt" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best_or_alt [26h])) - max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best="items_all_best" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best [26h]))) / (max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_with_entry="items_with_entry" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_with_entry [26h])) > 0) * 100

spec.title: Upgrades available
spec.description: Upgrades SeaDex recommends for your library, newest first. Upgrades where you already have a SeaDex alt are hidden unless you pick Show under Optional upgrades at the top. The Nyaa, AnimeBytes and Other columns show only when some upgrade has a link there.

spec.expr: sum by (al_id, arr, season, recommended_group, seadex_tags, info_hash, title, current_group, why, best, alt, nyaa_url, ab_url, public_url, arr_url) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `better release available` | json msg="msg", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", season="season", recommended_group="recommended_group", seadex_tags="seadex_tags", info_hash="info_hash", title="title", current_group="current_group", current_tier="current_tier", status="status", current_revision="current_revision", recommended_revision="recommended_revision", alt_groups="alt_groups", nyaa_url="nyaa_url", ab_url="ab_url", public_url="public_url", arr_url="arr_url" | msg=`better release available` | current_tier != "$optional" | label_format why=`{{ if eq .status "newer_revision" }}{{ .recommended_revision }} available{{ else if eq .current_tier "alt" }}SeaDex alt{{ else if eq .current_tier "unlisted" }}Neither best nor alt{{ else }}Better release{{ end }}`, current_group=`{{ .current_group | replace "," ", " }}{{ if .current_revision }} {{ .current_revision }}{{ end }}`, best=`{{ .recommended_group }}{{ if .recommended_revision }} {{ .recommended_revision }}{{ end }}`, alt=`{{ if .alt_groups }}{{ .alt_groups | replace "," ", " }}{{ else }}-{{ end }}` [2h]))

min by (al_id, arr, season, recommended_group, seadex_tags, info_hash, title) (min_over_time({container="$container"} |= `better release available` | json msg="msg", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", season="season", recommended_group="recommended_group", seadex_tags="seadex_tags", info_hash="info_hash", title="title", current_tier="current_tier" | msg=`better release available` | current_tier != "$optional" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000
and on (al_id, arr, season, recommended_group, seadex_tags, info_hash, title) sum by (al_id, arr, season, recommended_group, seadex_tags, info_hash, title) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `better release available` | json msg="msg", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", season="season", recommended_group="recommended_group", seadex_tags="seadex_tags", info_hash="info_hash", title="title", current_tier="current_tier" | msg=`better release available` | current_tier != "$optional" [2h]))

spec.title: Check by hand
spec.description: Findings seadex-scout could not decide on its own. Several groups on disk means your files mix release groups, and Untagged release means your file or SeaDex's release names no group. Open the title and compare it with SeaDex yourself.

spec.expr: sum by (al_id, arr, season, title, current_group, recommended_group, msg, arr_url) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `manual review` | json msg="msg", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", season="season", title="title", current_group="current_group", recommended_group="recommended_group", arr_url="arr_url" | msg=~`series spans multiple release groups, manual review|release group unverifiable, manual review` [2h]))

spec.title: Library overview
spec.description: SeaDex entries in your library, one per season or film SeaDex lists, grouped by what you have. Season not found means seadex-scout found no files for that season, because they are missing or Sonarr numbers that season differently, for example under specials. Unmapped specials are films or specials in Sonarr's specials that seadex-scout cannot tie to one entry. No summary yet means no daily library summary has arrived in the last 26 hours.

spec.expr: max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", have_best="have_best" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap have_best [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", have_alt="have_alt" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap have_alt [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", have_older_revision="have_older_revision" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap have_older_revision [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", have_unlisted="have_unlisted" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap have_unlisted [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", no_file="no_file" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap no_file [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", unverified="unverified" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap unverified [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", unattributed="unattributed" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap unattributed [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", not_on_seadex="not_on_seadex" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap not_on_seadex [26h]))

spec.title: Your anime against SeaDex, over time
spec.description: Your anime at each daily check, one point per check. The four parts add up to every anime in your library. A missing point means that day's check did not finish with a complete library read.

spec.expr: max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best="items_all_best" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best [$__interval])) and max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best_or_alt="items_all_best_or_alt" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best_or_alt [$__interval]))

max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best_or_alt="items_all_best_or_alt" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best_or_alt [$__interval])) - max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best="items_all_best" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best [$__interval]))

max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_with_entry="items_with_entry" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_with_entry [$__interval])) - max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best_or_alt="items_all_best_or_alt" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best_or_alt [$__interval]))

(max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", anime_items="anime_items" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap anime_items [$__interval])) - max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_with_entry="items_with_entry" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_with_entry [$__interval]))) and max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best_or_alt="items_all_best_or_alt" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best_or_alt [$__interval]))

spec.title: Why
spec.description: What keeps Status from showing ✓, over the last hour. A problem at SeaDex, AniList or the anime ID map needs nothing from you.

spec.expr: sum by (condition, arr) (count_over_time({container="$container"} | json level="level", condition="condition", arr="arr" | level=`ERROR` | condition!=`` [1h]))
sum by (msg) (count_over_time({container="$container"} | json level="level", condition="condition", msg="msg" | level=`ERROR` | condition=`` [1h]))

seadex-window-oversize.text: Too many SeaDex changes to fetch

spec.title: Last full check
spec.description: When the last full check finished. It runs once a day. Over 72 hours ago means the daily check has stopped, so the Upgrades table can be out of date and Status shows ✗.

spec.expr: max(max_over_time({container="$container"} |= `reconcile complete` | json msg="msg" | msg=`reconcile complete` | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap ts [72h])) * 1000

spec.title: Last check
spec.description: When the last check of any kind finished. It runs every 15 minutes by default. Over 3 hours ago means seadex-scout has stopped checking, so look at its container and its logs.

spec.expr: max(max_over_time({container="$container"} | json msg="msg" | msg=~`cycle complete|cycle degraded|tick complete|tick degraded` | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap ts [3h])) * 1000

spec.title: New feed releases in this range
spec.description: Releases the Torznab feed newly offered Sonarr and Radarr in this time range. It reads 0 when the feed is not set up. A 0 is also normal while SeaDex has curated nothing new.

spec.expr: sum(sum_over_time({container="$container"} |= `indexer feed snapshot written` | json msg="msg", journal_new="journal_new" | msg=`indexer feed snapshot written` | unwrap journal_new [$__range]))

spec.title: Feed polls per tracker
spec.description: How often Sonarr and Radarr read the Torznab feed, per tracker. Steady bars are normal, one count per RSS check. A tracker whose bars stop was turned off or marked failing in Sonarr or Radarr.

spec.expr: sum by (scope) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `indexer request` | json msg="msg", scope="scope", feed="feed" | msg=`indexer request` | feed=`true` [$__interval]))

spec.title: SeaDex Scout

spec.name: container
spec.label: Container
spec.description: The value of the container label your log collector puts on seadex-scout's lines.

spec.name: optional
spec.label: Optional upgrades
spec.description: Hide leaves out upgrades where you already have a SeaDex alt. Show lists them too.
